dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: You gotta turn your machines off from time to time, or else they'll just run until they get all busted up. Keep pushing 'em, and sooner or later, they might just blow up in your face! Humans are pretty much the same.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: So! I declare a snack break! Hehe, I snuck some krumkakes up my sleeves earlier. Here, have some!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: ...Just, uhh, checking... Y—You didn't bring Ineffa, did you?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Even for a genius like me, when I was slapping my first machine together, I didn't even know if I'd finish it!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Just goes to show you can't get anywhere if you don't start somewhere, right?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: So buckle up and try! Even if you have to take it apart and put it back together over and over again, maybe it'll suddenly all click into place!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I just had a look at that thingy over there... "A Mysterious Device That Can Play Music," huh?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: It's sooo cool... Just one look and I could tell, it has a totally different structure from the machines I've seen.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Okay, that's it, buddy! I'm so gonna take you apart... just gotta find my wrench first. Ugh, where in the krumkakes did I put that thing...?
